g.text: Sequence Diagram - Bank Transaction Ingestion & Automated Reconciliation (UC-20, UC-21, UC-22, FR-3.1, FR-3.2, FR-3.3, NFR-2.10)
Step 1: Banking API Transaction Ingestion (UC-21, FR-3.1)
[Banking API unavailable or returns an error]
Step 2: Automated Payment Reconciliation (UC-20, FR-3.2, FR-3.3)
DS-BASE: Alert Administrator of Unmatched Transaction (FR-4.2.2)
[Payment invalid, already processed or exceeds remaining balance]
[Customer has no other overdue or unpaid invoices]
[Remaining invoice balance is greater than zero]
Step 3: Manual Administrator Review & Resolution (UC-22, FR-3.3)
[Transaction unmatched, administrator authorized and amount valid]
[Customer has no other overdue or unpaid invoices]
